Package view

Class CalendarView

  • java.lang.Object
    • view.CalendarView
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    ICalendarView
    public class CalendarView
extends java.lang.Object
implements ICalendarView
    Implements the ICalendarView interface, responsible for presenting the calendar data to the user by outputting the response to a specified output medium. This class handles how the calendar system's information is displayed or printed.

    • Constructor Detail

      • CalendarView

        public CalendarView​(java.lang.Appendable out)
        Constructs a CalendarView instance with the specified output medium. This constructor allows you to specify where the calendar view data will be written to, such as the console or a file.
        Parameters:
        out - the Appendable output stream to which the response will be written.

    • Method Detail

      • outputResponse

        public void outputResponse​(java.lang.String data)
        Outputs the given data to the specified output medium. This method appends the data to the Appendable output stream. If an IOException occurs, it is ignored and no further action is taken.
        Specified by:
        outputResponse in interface ICalendarView
        Parameters:
        data - the data to be output to the user.

      • addFeatures

        public void addFeatures​(Features features)
        Description copied from interface: ICalendarView
        Registers a Features implementation with the view to enable interaction between the view and the controller.

        This allows the view to call back into the controller in response to user actions (e.g., button clicks, menu selections).

        Specified by:
        addFeatures in interface ICalendarView
        Parameters:
        features - the set of controller callbacks the view can invoke
